reasoning: A five-pointed star enclosed in a circle clearly reads as a reward token, loyalty point, rating, or starred favorite. It fits tasks about redeeming credit card/store points, writing customer reviews, and curating bookmarks, though it overlaps heavily with a plain star icon and must not be used merely to mark task priority.
